findings.title: Trailing whitespace can cause silent final-paragraph deletion
findings.reproduction:
Using existing BoundaryReviewRulesTests fixture, evaluate(NOTICE + '

' + BODY + '
') returns approval_eligible True and selected_span [194,1170], but BODY ends at1246. Removed suffix contains entire narrative paragraph13 plus whitespace.
findings.cause: _PARAGRAPH does not match a final paragraph followed by whitespace because it requires a nonwhitespace character immediately before end-of-string. Selection end falls back to previous paragraph.
findings.recommendation: Parse complete paragraph coverage robustly and verify every removed nonwhitespace piece is an exact recognized notice; test trailing spaces/newlines and other boundary whitespace.

findings.title: Known prior intent is ignored when omitted from cumulative directory
findings.reproduction: Using ReviewBatchEvidenceTests fixture, record an exclude disposition in a separate prior directory, pass an explicit source-anchored prior review and that prior directory, but leave cumulative dispositions empty. evaluate returns inventory unreviewed:1 and emits one new approval with qualified_boundary_rule resolution.
findings.recommendation: Require all explicitly supplied prior dispositions to be present in cumulative inventory, or reconcile their intents into it before deciding; include prior defer and conflicts.

findings.title: Inconsistent historical equality flag can undercount changed population
findings.reproduction: Using ReviewBatchEvidenceTests fixture, set old['body_equal']=True while normalized_before_sha256 != normalized_after_sha256. evaluate succeeds and summary reports historical_changed=0 and unresolved=[], despite recomputed normalization matching the unequal after hash.
findings.scope_note: Shared validation existed before delta; new batch consumption exposes same integrity gap.
findings.recommendation: For every compared row require valid before/after digests and body_equal equal to digest equality.
